review: 310.7-1: trigger_pending variant stopped with the trigger still on the stack although its decisions let it resolve; rewrote delta and expected to the resolved outcome (exiled, Kyren Flamewright cast, never in the graveyard).

310.9c-1: blocker_tapped variant flipped tapped-creature legality (509.1a), not 310.9c; replaced it with a does_not_fire variant where the only potential blocker belongs to the battle's controller, and added A's non-attacking Grizzly Bears to the setup.

skipped.reason: no non-Siege battle has been printed, so no Forge card can illustrate it
a battle's protector is not observable while the permanent is not a battle, and in a two-player game it is re-derived to the same opponent when it becomes one again, so no Forge outcome differs
no Forge card is a battle that is also an Aura, Equipment or Fortification, and no effect attaches a battle to a permanent, so it cannot arise

scenarios.title: A battle card can be cast only in a main phase of its owner's turn with an empty stack

setup.notes: Three untapped Mountains, so mana is never the reason a cast is illegal.

decisions: A holds priority with an empty stack; the legality of casting Invasion of Mercadia from hand is recorded.

variants.label: main_empty_stack
variants.expected: Casting Invasion of Mercadia is legal (can_play true).

variants.label: combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Casting Invasion of Mercadia is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player and the step is main1 of B's turn; A has priority.
variants.expected: Casting Invasion of Mercadia is not legal (can_play false).

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: Before the legality is recorded, A casts Lightning Bolt targeting B, tapping one Mountain, and holds priority with Lightning Bolt on the stack.
variants.expected: Casting Invasion of Mercadia is not legal (can_play false) even though two Mountains remain untapped.

scenarios.title: A resolving battle spell enters the battlefield under its controller's control

setup.notes: A's hand holds no other card, so the enters trigger of Invasion of Mercadia (discard a card, then draw two) has nothing to discard.

decisions: A casts Invasion of Mercadia, tapping both Mountains.
B passes priority; A passes priority; Invasion of Mercadia resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Invasion of Mercadia moves from the stack to the battlefield under A's control; nothing is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell targeting Invasion of Mercadia, tapping both Islands, before Invasion of Mercadia resolves.
variants.expected: Invasion of Mercadia is countered and moves to A's graveyard; it never reaches the battlefield. Counterspell moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A battle enters with defense counters equal to its printed defense

setup.notes: A's hand holds no other card, so the enters trigger finds nothing to discard.

decisions: A casts Invasion of Mercadia (printed defense 4), tapping Mountain and Plains.
Both players pass; Invasion of Mercadia resolves and enters.

variants.label: defense_4
variants.expected: Invasion of Mercadia enters with 4 defense counters on it.

variants.label: defense_3
variants.delta: A casts Invasion of Gobakhan (printed defense 3) instead of Invasion of Mercadia.
variants.expected: Invasion of Gobakhan enters with 3 defense counters on it.

variants.label: doubling_season
variants.delta: A also controls Doubling Season, which was on the battlefield before the cast.
variants.expected: Invasion of Mercadia enters with 8 defense counters, the 4 counters it would enter with doubled by Doubling Season.

scenarios.forge_notes: The doubling_season variant needs Doubling Season already on A's battlefield and an extra card in the setup; Forge's Doubling Season script restricts to counters on a permanent already in the battlefield zone, so it may not double a battle's enters-with counters. Invasion of Gobakhan's enters trigger targets B, whose hand is empty, so nothing is exiled.

scenarios.title: A Siege can be attacked by its controller, but never by its protector

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia, since only an opponent of a Siege's controller can protect it.

decisions: A moves to the declare attackers step; the legal attack targets of Grizzly Bears are recorded.

variants.label: controller_attacks
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears can legally attack B or Invasion of Mercadia.

variants.label: protector_attacks
variants.delta: Invasion of Mercadia is on B's battlefield (B controls it and A is its protector) instead of A's.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears can legally attack only B; Invasion of Mercadia is not a legal attack target because A, its protector, is the attacking player.

scenarios.forge_notes: Which player protects a Siege is not a record field; it shows in the legal attack targets.

scenarios.title: Combat damage dealt to a battle removes that many defense counters

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking Invasion of Mercadia.
B declares no blockers.
Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Invasion of Mercadia, removing 2 defense counters; it has 2 defense counters left and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares B's Grizzly Bears as a blocker of the attacking Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The attacking Grizzly Bears deals its 2 damage to the blocking Grizzly Bears, not to the battle; Invasion of Mercadia keeps 4 defense counters. Both Grizzly Bears die.

scenarios.title: Damage from a spell dealt to a battle removes that many defense counters

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Invasion of Mercadia, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; A passes priority; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: bolt_resolves
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Invasion of Mercadia, removing 3 defense counters; it has 1 defense counter left and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: bolt_countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell targeting Lightning Bolt, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt is countered and deals no damage; Invasion of Mercadia keeps 4 defense counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Lightning Bolt's 'Any' target must include battles in Forge's target validation.

scenarios.title: A Siege with 0 defense goes to the graveyard only when no ability it is the source of is pending

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Invasion of Mercadia, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves and removes the last 3 defense counters; Invasion of Mercadia's defeat trigger goes on the stack.
A casts Stifle targeting the defeat trigger, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Stifle resolves.

variants.label: trigger_stifled
variants.expected: The defeat trigger is countered. Invasion of Mercadia has 0 defense counters and is the source of no ability on the stack, so it moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check.

variants.label: trigger_pending
variants.delta: A does not cast Stifle; both players pass, the defeat trigger resolves, and A casts Invasion of Mercadia transformed without paying its mana cost.
variants.expected: Invasion of Mercadia is not put into the graveyard in the state-based checks while its defeat trigger is pending; the trigger exiles it and Kyren Flamewright (3/3) enters A's battlefield. A's graveyard holds only Lightning Bolt.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may implement the Siege's defeat trigger engine-side rather than in the card script.

scenarios.title: Removing a Siege's last defense counter triggers exiling it and casting it transformed

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Invasion of Mercadia, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves and removes 3 defense counters.
If the defeat trigger goes on the stack, both players pass and it resolves; A casts the exiled Siege transformed without paying its mana cost.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.expected: The last defense counter is removed, so the defeat trigger fires. Invasion of Mercadia is exiled and cast transformed: Kyren Flamewright (3/3 Goblin Spellshaper) enters A's battlefield; the Siege is not in any graveyard.

variants.label: counters_remain
variants.delta: Invasion of Mercadia has 4 defense counters instead of 3.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt removes 3 counters, leaving 1; the defeat trigger does not fire and Invasion of Mercadia stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Kyren Flamewright is the back face of Invasion of Mercadia.

scenarios.title: The protector may block creatures attacking the battle

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia. A controls two untapped Grizzly Bears; only one attacks.

decisions: A declares one Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking Invasion of Mercadia; A's other Grizzly Bears does not attack.
The legal blockers of the attacking Grizzly Bears are recorded.

variants.label: protector_creature
variants.expected: B's untapped Grizzly Bears is a legal blocker of the creature attacking Invasion of Mercadia; A's non-attacking Grizzly Bears is not.

variants.label: controller_creature_only
variants.delta: B's Grizzly Bears is not on the battlefield, so the only untapped non-attacking creature is A's, controlled by the battle's controller rather than its protector.
variants.expected: The creature attacking Invasion of Mercadia has no legal blocker; A's untapped Grizzly Bears cannot block it.

scenarios.forge_notes: In a two-player game the battle's controller is the attacking player, so Forge never offers A a block; the does_not_fire variant shows as no legal blocker for the attacker.

scenarios.title: The defending player for an attacked battle is its protector

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: A declares Falkenrath Perforator as an attacker, attacking Invasion of Mercadia.
Both players pass; Falkenrath Perforator's attack trigger resolves.

variants.label: attacks_battle
variants.expected: Falkenrath Perforator's trigger deals 1 damage to the defending player, B, the protector of the attacked battle: B is at 19 life and A stays at 20.

variants.label: attacks_player
variants.delta: Falkenrath Perforator attacks B directly instead of Invasion of Mercadia.
variants.expected: The trigger deals 1 damage to the defending player, B: B is at 19 life and A stays at 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: In a two-player game the protector of a Siege the attacker controls is always the attacked player, so the two variants agree; the protector is not a record field.

scenarios.title: A Siege whose controller becomes its protector gets a new protector

setup.notes: B is the protector of A's Invasion of Mercadia.

decisions: B casts Confiscate targeting Invasion of Mercadia, tapping six Islands.
Both players pass; Confiscate resolves.
B moves to the declare attackers step; the legal attack targets of Grizzly Bears are recorded.

variants.label: stolen_siege
variants.expected: B controls Invasion of Mercadia and can no longer protect it, so A becomes its protector and B stops being it. Grizzly Bears can legally attack A or Invasion of Mercadia.

variants.label: stolen_land
variants.delta: Confiscate targets A's Mountain instead of Invasion of Mercadia.
variants.expected: A still controls Invasion of Mercadia and B is still its protector. Grizzly Bears can legally attack only A.

scenarios.forge_notes: Protector is not a record field; the reassignment shows in the legal attack targets. The graveyard branch of 310.11 (no player can be chosen) cannot arise in a two-player game.
